anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch), the bottom edge of U2 (STM32L476RGT6) shows pin 12 (VDDA) wired into the same horizontal rail as pins 32/47/60 (VSS) and 13 (VSSA), and that rail terminates in a GND symbol. The VCC rail at the top of U2 connects only pins 22, 43 (VDD) and 48 (VDDUSB); VDDA is not joined to it.
anomalies.expected: VDDA is the MCU's analog power supply and must be connected to VCC (typically with its own decoupling), never to GND. Spec §4 defines VCC and GND as the two global rails and the MCU's VDD pins sit on VCC; tying VDDA to GND contradicts the part's function and standard practice.

evidence.quote: Root sheet, bottom of U2: stubs '32 VSS 47 VSS 60 VSS 13 VSSA 12 VDDA' all joined by one green line ending at the GND arrow
PCB.cir is a flat SPICE netlist with two global rails, VCC and GND ... Decoupling / bulk capacitance directly on VCC-GND

anomalies.impact: The analog supply is shorted to ground: the ADC/DAC, analog reference and any VDDA-dependent circuitry cannot operate, and the MCU may draw excessive current or fail to start correctly.

parsed.summary: Most of the build matches the specification (correct pull-up/IREF/charge-pump values, I2C-style BS strapping and D0/D1+D2 mapping, 1 k series / 22 n sampling touch topology, SWD on PA13/PA14/PB3, VOUT and VBAT to VCC); the reference designators are simply renumbered, which is not an anomaly. The one deviation I can read off the drawing is that the MCU's VDDA pin (U2.12) is wired into the bottom GND rail instead of VCC, shorting the analog supply to ground.
